claim: The AI data center load shape is changing and data architectures have advanced, so places like Alaska's North Slope become not only viable, but we argue that they have become inevitable.

sources.story_title: Asserter: Sparrow Mahoney (CEO, STAK Energy) 'inevitable' quote at the March 2026 DOE/ORNL workshop; also carries the 'powered by natural gas from the adjacent Prudhoe Bay field' sourcing claim

Counter-evidence: no firm gas supply agreement; pipeline route 'anywhere between 25 and 90 miles'; Antony Scott 'That means they don't have a gas supply'; plant would burn more than twice urban Alaska's total gas use; minimal North Slope gas-to-market infrastructure

Counter-evidence: Chugach Electric (Hasquet) 'We currently do not have gas to serve a large data center'; Pickett 'world of hurt'; Hilcorp contract concludes 2028; GVEA Cook Inlet gas share fell ~30% to <1%
